manifest.name: dsh-superagent
manifest.author: DeepSeek Harness Team <team@dsh.dev>
manifest.description: A proactive agent for one repository, as a DSH (DeepSeek Harness) bundle: it listens to GitHub or a self-hosted GitLab and optionally to Feishu and DingTalk chats, evaluates requests under a Policy, turns authorized ones into Tickets, and executes each in its own DSH Session.

scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build

bundle.text:
# dsh-superagent bundle layer: inserts the plugins without configuration, and the agent presets its Sessions run under. The
# profile supplies the `dsh-superagent` entry's stateDir (see docs/006-deployment.md and examples/profile.cordis.patch.yml); the plugin
# refuses to start without stateDir.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-superagent
      name: dsh-superagent
    - id: dsh-superagent-github
      name: dsh-superagent/github-watch
    # Optional Feishu Source; requires configuring a bot CLI after enabling.
    - id: dsh-superagent-feishu
      name: dsh-superagent/feishu-watch
      disabled: true
    # Optional GitLab Source for a self-hosted GitLab; an installation works on one repository, so set this Source or the GitHub one, not
    # both (the GitHub plugin may be disabled then); requires configuring a project and an agent glab CLI after enabling.
    - id: dsh-superagent-gitlab
      name: dsh-superagent/gitlab-watch
      disabled: true
    # Optional DingTalk Source; requires configuring a dingtalk-bot CLI after enabling.
    - id: dsh-superagent-dingtalk
      name: dsh-superagent/dingtalk-watch
      disabled: true
    # The agent preset of every Executor Session (WORKER_PRESET in src/app/sessions.ts); the main Session has its own, below.
    # It is DSH's `standard` preset with only what a worker needs, and a shell whose foreground command moves to a background job
    # after 5 seconds, so a long command does not hold back a person's message, which the Session takes at its next step. Left
    # out: questions to a person, presenting, plan mode, the plugin manager and market, scheduling, goals, workflows, web fetch,
    # and forked subagents, which would run under this preset; spawned subagents run under `standard`, whose shell moves a
    # command to a background job only after 60 seconds, as a subagent's jobs are killed when it ends. A preset row has no
    # setting that hides it from the preset picker, so its name and description say whom it is for.
    - id: dsh-superagent-worker-preset
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: dsh-superagent-worker
        name: dsh-superagent 执行器
        description: dsh-superagent 的执行器 Session 专用，不供手动选择。前台命令超 5 秒转入后台，只含执行工作所需的工具。
        order: 90
        plugins:
          - id: persona
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona'
            config:
              prefix: You are a coding agent powered by the {{model}} model.
          - id: agent-instructions
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions'
            config:
              maxBytes: 65536
          - id: time-context
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-time-context'
          # A foreground command waits at most 5 s, then the shell tool moves it to a background job.
          - id: shell
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              shell: true
            config:
              - id: bash-sandbox
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-bash-sandbox'
                disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'
                config:
                  timeoutMs: 5000
                  maxTimeoutMs: 5000
              - id: pwsh-sandbox
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-pwsh-sandbox'
                disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
                config:
                  timeoutMs: 5000
                  maxTimeoutMs: 5000
              - id: tool-bash
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash'
                disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'
              - id: tool-pwsh
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-pwsh'
                disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
          - id: tool-fs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs'
          - id: tool-fs-search
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs-search'
            config:
              sampleOverCapGlobResults: false
          # A wait for a job ends after 5 s too; the job's end wakes the worker with its result.
          - id: tool-jobs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-jobs'
            config:
              waitTimeoutMs: 5000
              maxWaitTimeoutMs: 5000
          - id: skill-filesystem
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem'
          - id: tool-skill
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-skill'
          - id: compaction
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              compaction: true
              toolResultPruner: true
            config:
              - id: compaction-basic
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic'
              - id: command-compact
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-compact'
              - id: tool-result-pruner
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner'
                config:
                  thresholdChars: 8192
                  headChars: 4096
                  tailChars: 1024
          - id: delegation
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              workflowEngine: true
            config:
              - id: tool-subagent-control
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent-control'
              - id: tool-subagent
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent'
                config:
                  provider: spawn
                  toolName: subagent
                  modelSelection: true
                  modelDiscovery: true
                  agentPreset: standard
          - id: tool-todo
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-todo'
            config:
              allowParallelInProgress: true
          - id: tool-web
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-web'
            config:
              fetch: false
              searchTimeoutMs: 60000
    # The agent preset of the main Session (ROUTER_PRESET in src/app/sessions.ts). The worker's 5-second shell and job waits, so a command or a wait does not hold back the next candidates, and
    # only what the main Session uses: no subagents, web, file search or writes, todo list, questions to a person, presenting,
    # plan mode, plugin manager, scheduling, goals or workflows. No persona: the main Session's prompt is complete, so it has
    # no other section.
    - id: dsh-superagent-router-preset
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset'
      config:
        id: dsh-superagent-router
        name: dsh-superagent 主 Session
        description: dsh-superagent 的主 Session 专用，不供手动选择。前台命令和任务等待超 5 秒转入后台，只含路由所需的工具。
        order: 91
        plugins:
          - id: agent-instructions
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-instructions'
            config:
              maxBytes: 65536
          - id: time-context
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-time-context'
          - id: shell
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              shell: true
            config:
              - id: bash-sandbox
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-bash-sandbox'
                disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'
                config:
                  timeoutMs: 5000
                  maxTimeoutMs: 5000
              - id: pwsh-sandbox
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-pwsh-sandbox'
                disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
                config:
                  timeoutMs: 5000
                  maxTimeoutMs: 5000
              - id: tool-bash
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash'
                disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32'
              - id: tool-pwsh
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-pwsh'
                disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32'
          - id: tool-fs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs'
            config:
              write: false
              edit: false
          - id: tool-jobs
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-jobs'
            config:
              waitTimeoutMs: 5000
              maxWaitTimeoutMs: 5000
          - id: skill-filesystem
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem'
          - id: tool-skill
            name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-skill'
          - id: compaction
            name: cordis:group
            group: true
            isolate:
              compaction: true
              toolResultPruner: true
            config:
              - id: compaction-basic
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic'
              - id: command-compact
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-compact'
              - id: tool-result-pruner
                name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner'
                config:
                  thresholdChars: 8192
                  headChars: 4096
                  tailChars: 1024

readme.text: **能接自建 GitLab 和钉钉的主动式编程智能体：在群里 @ 它派活，它自己开工单、写代码、提 MR，再回到原对话里交付。** 基于 DeepSeek 开源的 [dsh-superagent-prototype](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype)，由社区独立维护 [](https://github.com/chunonesoft/open-superagent/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [](LICENSE) [](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype) 简体中文 · [English](README.en.md)
> [!NOTE] > 本项目是社区维护的独立分支，**不是 DeepSeek 官方产品，与 DeepSeek 没有隶属关系**。官方仓库不接受外部 PR，所以我们把补充的能力放在这里单独维护，并定期合并上游更新。和上游一样，它是研究原型，不是生产级软件，接入团队前请先阅读[安全须知](#安全须知)。

dsh-superagent 是 DeepSeek 团队开源的一套「主动式编程智能体」，跑在 [DeepSeek Harness](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/) 上。它不是一个等你开对话的聊天框，而是团队里的一个成员：

- **在你们平时干活的地方听需求**：Issue、PR 评论、群聊里的 @。
- **按团队写好的规则决定接不接**：谁可以派活、什么活能主动做，都写在策略里。
- **每件事开一个工单**，在独立的会话和目录里干活，互不干扰。
- **结果回到原对话**：一个 PR/MR、一段调查结论，或者一个需要你拍板的问题。
- **一个 Web 面板**只列出需要人处理的事，健康状态不占地方。

核心原则只有一句：**尽量少占用人的注意力，尽量多给出价值。**（见 [000 理念](docs/000-philosophy.md)）
官方原型只支持 **github.com + 飞书**。而国内很多团队的代码在**内网自建 GitLab**，沟通在**钉钉**，官方版本接不进来，官方仓库又不收外部贡献。open-superagent 补上了这两块，并保持和上游同步。

| | 官方原型 | open-superagent |
| --- | :---: | :---: |
| GitHub（Issue / PR / 评论 / CI） | ✅ | ✅ |
| 飞书（群聊 / 私聊 / 话题） | ✅ | ✅ |
| **自建 GitLab**（Todo / MR / 评论 / 流水线，支持相对路径部署） | — | ✅ |
| **钉钉**（@机器人、私聊、Stream 模式，无需公网回调） | — | ✅ |
| **钉钉白名单按部门同步**（含所有子部门） | — | ✅ |
| 只接聊天、不接代码平台（用于排查、调研类工作） | — | ✅ |
| 统一的代码平台接口（新增平台只需实现一个 Source） | — | ✅ |
| 按对话语言回复（中文群里回中文） | — | ✅ |
| worker 不会用到运维人员自己的 SSH 密钥 | — | ✅ |
| 定期合并上游更新 | — | ✅ |

全部改动见 [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md)。

以下对话为示意。

**钉钉群里派活**

> 张三：@小助手 订单列表页分页从第二页开始就重复了，帮忙看下
>
> 小助手：收到，我去查订单列表的分页逻辑，修好后提 MR。
>
> （二十分钟后）小助手：已修复：分页游标用的是创建时间，同一秒的订单会重复。改成了「创建时间 + id」，MR：!128

**GitLab MR 里追加要求**：在 MR 下评论 `@agent 顺便补一个分页的单测`，它会接着在同一个工单里改，合并后工单自动结束。

**只接钉钉/飞书、不接代码平台**：用来做「帮我查一下昨天的报错是哪次提交引入的」这类调研，结论直接回到群里。

需要：Node.js 22.19+ 或 24+、pnpm、git 2.32+、tmux、Python 3.8+、[DeepSeek Harness](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/)（版本见 `package.json` 的 `engines.dsh`），以及所选平台的 CLI（GitHub 用 `gh`，GitLab 用 `glab`，飞书用 `lark-cli`；钉钉的 `dingtalk-bot` 已内置）。

```sh
git clone https://github.com/chunonesoft/open-superagent.git
cd open-superagent
pnpm install && pnpm check
```

配置步骤较多，推荐让你的编程智能体（Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等）带你走完：

> 读一下这个仓库的 SETUP.md，带我把 dsh-superagent 配好。
它会一次只问一个问题，问完后给出完整计划，你确认后再执行。也可以照着 [006 部署](docs/006-deployment.md) 手动配置。

| 文档 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| [000 理念](docs/000-philosophy.md) | 为什么它默认安静、只在被请求时行动 |
| [001 领域模型](docs/001-domain.md) | Source、Trigger、Eval、Ticket 这些概念 |
| [002 授权](docs/002-authorization.md) | 谁能派活、白名单、主动工作的规则 |
| [003 执行](docs/003-execution.md) | 工单怎么在独立会话里执行 |
| [004 提示词](docs/004-prompts.md) | 团队如何改写智能体的行为 |
| [005 面板](docs/005-panel.md) | Web 面板的各个页签 |
| [006 部署](docs/006-deployment.md) | 账号、安装、配置、升级和排错 |
| [007 架构](docs/007-architecture.md) | 模块和测试一览 |
| [008 扩展手册](docs/008-cookbook.md) | 如何新增一个 Source |

- worker 以 `danger-full-access` 权限、用运行它的系统账号身份执行，能读该账号的主目录。**请用一个只放智能体凭据的独立系统账号运行**，尤其不要放在登录了生产系统 CLI 的机器上。
- 智能体在代码平台上用的账号应是**专门的机器人账号**，不要用你自己的。
- 先用很短的白名单起步，主动工作先只记录不执行，确认行为符合预期后再放开。

详见 [006 部署 · 权限与隔离](docs/006-deployment.md#permissions-and-isolation)。发现安全问题请按 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) 私下报告。

欢迎提 Issue 和 PR，尤其是：新的 Source（企业微信、Gitee、Gitea……）、中文文档翻译、真实团队的使用反馈。开始前请看 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)。

`pnpm check` 会跑类型检查、全部测试和构建。

核心设计与实现来自 DeepSeek Harness Team 开源的 [dsh-superagent-prototype](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype)，以及文章 *Exploring Super-agent Design: Towards a More Autonomous Agent System*。本仓库在 [MIT](LICENSE) 许可下保留原版权声明。

如果它对你有帮助，点个 ⭐ 让更多用 GitLab 和钉钉的团队看到。

[简体中文](README.md) · English

**A community-maintained fork of [deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh-superagent-prototype) that adds a self-hosted GitLab Source and a DingTalk Source.** It is not affiliated with DeepSeek. The upstream repository does not accept outside contributions, so this fork carries them and merges upstream regularly. See the [comparison with upstream](README.md#为什么要有社区版) and the [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md).

> **Research prototype for reference only, not an official DeepSeek product.** This code grew out of our team's day-to-day development work, with much of the engineering done by coding agents. Treat it as research code, not production-ready software. It may still contain bugs, and its coding style and engineering practices may be inconsistent. Review and adapt it before using it in your own environment.
>
> We have adapted it for publication, so it is not identical to our internal version or the implementation described in *Exploring Super-agent Design: Towards a More Autonomous Agent System*. Some designs discussed in the article are directions for future development and are not implemented in this prototype.

dsh-superagent is a proactive coding agent for one repository, packaged as a bundle for [DeepSeek Harness](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/). It listens to GitHub or a self-hosted GitLab and, optionally, to Feishu and DingTalk chats. When someone allowed asks the agent for work, it opens a work item, works on it in its own agent session and directory, and answers in the original conversation, for example with a pull request. A web panel shows what needs a person.

It is also a way of working with an agent: **take as little human attention as possible, and give as much value as possible.** An agent that can act for a whole team can also waste a whole team's attention, so it acts only when asked or when a rule the team wrote allows it, and speaks only when someone must act or can use a result. [docs/000-philosophy.md](docs/000-philosophy.md) explains the principle and what it asks of the operator.

Setup has many steps, so an agent does it with you. Ask your coding agent:

> Read SETUP.md in this repository and set up dsh-superagent with me.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/chunonesoft/open-superagent.git
cd open-superagent && pnpm install && pnpm check
```

It asks one short question at a time, shows the full plan once, and then installs and configures everything. [SETUP.md](SETUP.md) is what it follows.

- [000 Philosophy](docs/000-philosophy.md)
- [001 Domain model](docs/001-domain.md)
- [002 Authorization](docs/002-authorization.md)
- [003 Execution](docs/003-execution.md)
- [004 Prompts](docs/004-prompts.md)
- [005 Panel](docs/005-panel.md)
- [006 Deployment](docs/006-deployment.md): manual setup, configuration, upgrades and troubleshooting
- [007 Architecture](docs/007-architecture.md)
- [008 Cookbook](docs/008-cookbook.md): adding a Source
`pnpm check` runs the typecheck, the tests and the build.
Issues and pull requests are welcome, especially new Sources (WeCom, Gitee, Gitea, ...). See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).
